hints: Find the exact cosine values for $\alpha$ and $\beta$: $\cos\alpha = \sqrt{1 - 0.28^2} = 0.96$ and $\cos\beta = \sqrt{1 - 0.6^2} = 0.8$.
Resolve all four forces horizontally in equilibrium: $F\cos\theta + 40\cos\beta - 30\cos\alpha - 20\cos 60^\circ = 0$, and solve for $F\cos\theta$.
Resolve all four forces vertically in equilibrium: $F\sin\theta + 20\sin 60^\circ - 30\sin\alpha - 40\sin\beta = 0$, and solve for $F\sin\theta$.
Divide the two equations to find $\tan\theta$, and use Pythagoras theorem to find $F$.
walkthrough:
First, compute the corresponding cosine values for angles $\alpha$ and $\beta$ using the trigonometric identity $\cos^2\phi + \sin^2\phi = 1$:
- For angle $\alpha$: $\cos\alpha = \sqrt{1 - (0.28)^2} = \sqrt{1 - 0.0784} = \sqrt{0.9216} = 0.96$
- For angle $\beta$: $\cos\beta = \sqrt{1 - (0.6)^2} = \sqrt{1 - 0.36} = \sqrt{0.64} = 0.8$

State the conditions for coplanar equilibrium of forces at a point:
$$\sum F_x = 0\quad\text{and}\quad \sum F_y = 0$$

Resolve all forces along the horizontal $x$-axis:
$$F\cos\theta + 40\cos\beta - 30\cos\alpha - 20\cos 60^\circ = 0$$
Substitute the known trigonometric values:
$$F\cos\theta + 40(0.8) - 30(0.96) - 20(0.5) = 0$$
$$F\cos\theta + 32 - 28.8 - 10 = 0$$
$$F\cos\theta - 6.8 = 0$$
$$F\cos\theta = 6.8\text{ N}$$

Resolve all forces along the vertical $y$-axis:
$$F\sin\theta + 20\sin 60^\circ - 30\sin\alpha - 40\sin\beta = 0$$
Substitute the known values:
$$F\sin\theta + 20(0.866025) - 30(0.28) - 40(0.6) = 0$$
$$F\sin\theta + 17.32051 - 8.4 - 24 = 0$$
$$F\sin\theta + 17.32051 - 32.4 = 0$$
$$F\sin\theta - 15.07949 = 0$$
$$F\sin\theta = 15.07949\text{ N}$$

Divide the vertical component equation by the horizontal component equation to find $\theta$:
$$\tan\theta = \frac{F\sin\theta}{F\cos\theta} = \frac{15.07949}{6.8} \approx 2.21757$$
$$\theta = \arctan(2.21757) \approx 65.73^\circ$$
Rounding to one decimal place gives $\theta = 65.7^\circ$.

Calculate the magnitude $F$ using the Pythagorean theorem:
$$F = \sqrt{(F\cos\theta)^2 + (F\sin\theta)^2} = \sqrt{(6.8)^2 + (15.07949)^2}$$
$$F = \sqrt{46.24 + 227.3910} = \sqrt{273.6310} \approx 16.5418\text{ N}$$
Rounding to three significant figures gives $F = 16.5\text{ N}$.
Thus $F = 16.5\text{ N}$ and $\theta = 65.7^\circ$.
